1. EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
1.1 INTRODUCTION

SATYA RANJAN COLLEGE is located at Brahman-Gram, Kalain of Cachar District of Assam. The College
was established in the year of 1992 to fulfil the hopes & aspirations of the people of greater Katigorah L.A
Constituency. Infact, it was the first Higher Educational institution in the Katigorah L.A Constituency of
Assam.

Till 2012, the college was at venture-stage and the teacher’s honorarium were paid off from the college fund.
Finally in the year 2013, the Govt. of Assam, provincialized the service of 05 Asst.Prof. including Principal and
all non-teaching staffs of the college. In the year 2014, 02 more posts had been regularized. And finally in the
year 2021, all teaching posts got sanctioned.

Since establishment, the infrastructural development of the College was at very slow pace as internally there
was very limited source to raise fund. On the other hand, due to not having NAAC-Accreditation, the College
was not able to get permanent affiliation from the University and get 12 B status to receive financial assistance
for infrastructural development. So, the college took a bold decision to invite NAAC with the objective to
prepare a road map for the overall development of the college with the recommendation of academic experts.

The college is affiliated to Assam University, Silchar and presently offering B.A in General-Programme in 8
subjects viz., Bengali, Economics, Arabic, English, History, Political Science, Manipuri, and Philosophy as
well as B.A in Hons-programme in 3 subjects viz- Economics, Bengali and Political-Science.

Presently, there are 19 permanent teaching faculties viz- 14 Assistant Professor and 5 Tutor Assistant professor
in various departments in the college (13 Male+06 female). And 12 Non-teaching staffs (10 Male+02 Female).
It has also 01- Assistant Librarian and 01 Library Assistant.

The College is located in a rural campus occupying about 5.15 acres land in Kalain area of Cachar District of
Assam. The College is functioning under the leadership of the Governing Body which is also registered under
Societies Registration Act-1986. and guiding the society with a clear vision. The College is determined to
become a pioneer institution of higher education in the state of Assam.


Vision

To impart higher education for all sections of the society, especially to the under privileged section and
strengthening the Socio-economic base of the surrounding area through quality higher education.


Mission

         To increase the accessibility to higher education and act as a catalyst of social transformation by
         spreading education for all & especially to the marginalized segments of the society.

         Maximizing efforts for grooming young energetic human resources to achieve excellence in academic,

1.2 Strength, Weakness, Opportunity and Challenges(SWOC)
Institutional Strength

       Satya Ranjan College is approximately 200 meters away from NH 44 highway. Therefore, the college is
       easily reachable.
       College is located in a comparatively pollution free, crime free and peaceful region. Hence an ideal
       place for learning.
       The college has a visionary management team to lead the institution towards achieving higher academic
       excellence.
       The NSS, NCC, Women Cell of the College are very dynamic that actively engage in nation building
       and community service.
       A strong relationship with the neighbourhood communities due to collaborative extension works.
       The College has dedicated teaching and non-teaching staffs, and a satisfactory student strength, with
       students hailing from different communities.
       A well-documented student-centric teaching-learning process.
       Performance of students in university exams have been satisfactory and upgrading in recent times.
       Gender-friendly premises. Safe and secured environment for the girl students and staffs is maintained.
       E-resources accessible to students through the library.
       The College attempts to stay updated with emerging trends in higher education and has gradually
       incorporating student-centric ICT enabled quality enhanced learning.

      Well-designed Perspective Plan and Policies.
      Well-structured, participatory and decentralized governance.
      The college is situated at rural area and near to the Indo-Bangladesh International Border. It is infect,
      the only higher educational institution in the greater Katigorah LA Constituency of Assam. Right
      from the establishment, the college has been providing the opportunities of Higher Education to the
      educationally and economically weaker sections of the society.
      The alumni association and Governing Body of the college is registered under Societies Registration
      Act-1986.
      Linkage established with reputed institutions and MoU signed to undertake collaborative works.


Institutional Weakness

      Not having NAAC Accreditation is the major weakness of the Institution.
      Lack of fund and sufficient infrastructural and ICT facilities.
      The college is located in a flood affected area and during flood academic environment is badly affected.
      Remote area and poor internet connectivity.
      The number of students taking admission in some departments / programmes are comparatively less due
      to several socio-economic and educational setup in the surrounding area.
      Limited number of programmes/courses with only arts stream and till now there is no scope for the
      students aspiring for higher studies in science and commerce.
      Most of the students are from poor financial background and this affects their learning environment and
      also the scope of introducing self-financing courses is limited due to the weak financial background of
      the majority of learners.
      The case of dropout is visible due to several socio-economic factors.
      Limited Staff in some department is another weakness of the College.
      Almost 99% students coming to the college are from vernacular medium. They feel difficult to
      understand and respond in the classroom setting is another weakness of the college.


Institutional Opportunity

      As the College is located in remote area, the College has the scope for expansion of infrastructure in
      diverse aspects.
      Geographically the college is situated in rural area and most of the student’s taking admission in the
      college belong from BPL category. Many aspiring students passing from this institution could not get
      opportunity to pursue PG degree due to various social-economic reasons. Hence the College has
      opportunities to introduce more courses in UG and PG program under the distance learning programmes
      like IDOL, IGNOU, KKHSOU, etc.
      College has the opportunity to introduce different skill development courses along with some science
      and commerce programs.
      College has the opportunity to work more for expanding e-learning.
      As the College is situated near to Indo-Bangladesh International border, The college has opportunity for
      expansion in the field of research, particularly on border & local issues.
      The college has the opportunity to work in the field of developing small scale and cottage industries on
      the basis of local resources in an innovative way.
      The College can initiate Sports Training Programme for giving greater number of students the
      opportunity to develop an interest in sports.

       The surrounding area of the college is affected by heavy flood every year which poses a great challenge
       to maintain the academic environment of the college.
        scarcity of funds for its infrastructural development to provide best facilities to its learners in order to
       make them globally competent.

       The problem of student’s dropout is another major challenge of the college. As the majority of the
       students belong to families with lower socioeconomic background, the parents' priority is source of
       income. As a result, when parents feel their wards have become capable to work, the focus shifts from
       studies to employment, this leads to drop out from college.
       To ensure placement to the students passing out from this institution.
       To motivate the students to pursue skill based self-financing courses due to lack of awareness and
       financial requirements.
       Preparing and motivating students for participation in co-curricular activities like game sports is a
       challenging factor due to the lack of interest and not having the post of PT teacher provided by the State
       Govt.



1.3 CRITERIA WISE SUMMARY
Curricular Aspects

Being an affiliated college, this institution follows the curriculum pattern designed by the University. Some
important points of curricular aspects are-

       The process of curriculum delivery of the various courses that runs currently in the institution is planned
       by Academic Planning and Development committee.
       The IQAC at the beginning of the academic-year conducts meetings with all HoDs and plans for
       effective norms to achieve the best learning outcomes. It includes curriculum implementation, semester
       teaching Plans, internal examination schedule, teaching plan of each department, identifying delivery
       modes, developing teaching aids etc. for effective implementation of curriculum by each staff member.


       Before commencement of classes, All the faculty members sit together and divide the syllabus contents
       with respect to Paper, Unit and Topics to be dealt & monitors its progress.

       The faculty members provide study-Materials Printed and hand-written to the students at the completion
       of a Unit/Topic. Chalk and talk, demonstrations, audio-visual, field visits etc., are used in the delivery
       process.

       The Academic-Planning and Development-Committee of the College prepares an Annual Academic
       Calendar based on the Holiday list of the Assam University.

       A Central Routine is also prepared by the Academic Planning and Development committee. All HoDs
      distribute the courses amongst the faculty members and prepare the departmental time table accordingly.

      Class attendances of the students are recorded in the Class Register Books. Tutorial and remedial
      classes are taken for maintaining the student’s participatory learning for slow learners and students with
      poor performance.

      The institution holds two internal examinations for every semester and One Sessional Examination as
      per the norms of the affiliating University.

      The institution integrates cross-cutting issues like professional ethics, gender sensitization, human
      values, environmental issues and sustainability into the curriculum by observing National days, World
      Environment Day, International Yoga Day, International Women’s Day etc.

      The faculty members of the College participate in assessment/Evaluation process for UG programmes
      of the Assam University.

      The Institution collect and analyze Feedbacks on various aspects of curriculum and submit to the
      authority for necessary action.




Teaching-learning and Evaluation

      Satya Ranjan College follows the guidelines and directions of the Government of India for the
      enrolment of the students against the reserved categories.

      The admission of students is done through college admission portal following the guidelines laid down
      by the Directorate of Higher Education, Assam and the affiliating University.

      A large number of students belong from Below Poverty Line category take admission in the college
      every year.

       Altogether 19 permanent faculty members of the college, out of which 7 have Ph.D, 6 have M.Phil
      degree, and 10 are NET/SET qualified , assess the learning level of the students.

      The college assesses the learning levels of newly admitted students by conducting orientation program,
      conduct bridge courses etc.

      Remedial Classes, Peer Teaching are conducted for slow learners.

      Interactive sessions, invited talks and seminars, group discussion, field trips, and various activities such
      as Quiz, Extempore speech, sports week organized by different cells, and committees to promote
      experiential learning.

      Use of ICT-based teaching learning tools such as projector, TV, Google Classroom, Teachmint,
      WhatsApp group, YouTube audio/video class etc. are encouraged to supplement the classroom learning.

       The evaluation process of the college is unbiased, progressive, properly monitored and transparent. The
       students have access to their evaluated answer scripts. Any grievance or discrepancy in the internal
       evaluation is resolved at the earliest in the department level itself.

       Parents-teachers’ meetings are held sometimes inform the parents about students’ performance and to
       address specific issues if any.

       Mentor-mentee system has been initiated in the academic session 2021-22 to make the teaching,
       learning, evaluation more transparent and effective.

       Presently the Teacher- Student full time ratio is 1:33

       The average pass percentage of final year students during the last five years is 50.23%




Research, Innovations and Extension

To shape the growth of the intellectual and general wellbeing of the students belonging to various sections of
the society, attempts have been made through different academic as well as co- curricular activities. Some
points related to research, Innovation and Extension may be highlighted by the following points-

       Nature and bio diversity conservation, preservation of culture, traditional knowledge, Environment,
       gender related issues have been focal areas of the extension activities to involve with and also to
       sensitize the students.
       Issues like that of self-defense for girls and children, legal awareness, corruption and its evil, importance
       of Yoga and heal, hygiene &cleanliness etc. have been the highlights of the activities along with the
       college students and local people of nearby villages.
       Career counseling for the students, short term skill training sessions on soft skills, self-defense, yoga etc
       have been provided time to time.
       The college has a number of collaborations/linkages for faculty exchange, students exchange,
       participating in extension activities, social activities etc. It has a MoU with West Silchar College,
       Nilambazar College, Maibang Degree College. It has a MoU signed with NGO -Netaji Chatro Yuva
       Sangstha and Kalain Divine Foundation for participation in different social activities.
       Apart from that, the academic departments of the college have organized several departmental
       seminars/workshops during the last five years as a part of experiential learning. The faculty members
       were also involved in publishing book chapters in edited volumes, and papers in national/ international
       conference proceedings.
       The college has active and functional National Service Scheme and National Cadet Corps Units. In
       addition to these, the college also has Women's Cell, Electoral Literacy Club, Natures Club, Red-
       Ribbon Club, Student’s Union etc. Further, the ACTA (Assam College Teachers Association) Satya
       Ranjan college unit also contributes a significant role in community development.
       The NCC and NSS unit of Satya Ranjan College organize cleanliness drives, tobacco control
       programme, tree plantation drives, different awareness camps, training programs, health camps, covid
       awareness programmes etc. in the neighboring villages.


Infrastructure and Learning Resources

The institution is depended upon very limited financial resources & till now the college has not received any
financial assistance from UGC / RUSA for infrastructural development. The institution is single stream "Arts"
under graduate degree college with eight subjects and is located at primarily in a rural setting having 5.15 acre
land with approximately 1287 sq. meter builtup area.

       The College is having one G+1 RCC building and the rest are all of assam type house.
       The college has adequate number of classrooms including 2 digital classroom having LCD projector and
       TV, sound system with Wifi connectivity.
       There is one temporary auditorium in the college. The auditorium is used as classroom and when needed
       it is used as auditorium.
       CCTV cameras are installed in the college campus.
       There are separate common room for boys and Girls. The Girls common room is equipped with sanitary
       napkin vending machine.
       The college has 6 number of computers installed in library for students, 03 numbers in the office room
       and 01 for IQAC along with printer, scanner and xerox facility for both staffs and students.
       Satya Ranjan College Library using LibWare ILS 2.0 library automation software with Barcode
       technology. The Library is a member of the N-LIST and also a club member of NDLI.
       The library staffs regularly update the question papers of University examination in College website.
       The college provides safe drinking water facilities to the students by using modern means of water
       purifiers and chiller.
       The institution has a 3.KV environment friendly power generator and 2 sets of inverters including 1
       solar powered to deal with the power disruption
       The college has a college canteen inside the college campus.

The institution provides adequate indoor games facilities like carrom board, chess, etc. and it also provides
facilities for outdoor games like volleyball, musical chair, cricket, kabaddi, badminton etc. The college
encourages different cultural activities like dance, drama, songs, literary competitions like wall magazines, on
the spot poem writing etc


Student Support and Progression

       The students the college are beneifted by all govt. funded scholarships and freeships is given to all BPL
       category students under a Assam Govt. scheme
       Apart from class room teaching learning, the college motivates student to participate in different co-
       curricular & Extension activities throughout the year.
       The college has a students’ feedback system in place which is regularly monitored.
       There is not a single case of ragging or any case of sexual harrassment in the college in the last five
       years. There are committees like anti-ragging committee, Grievance Redressal Committee to address
       any problem related with such cases.
       Remedial classes are arranged for the slow learners.
       Sports and Cultural programmes are organnized for physical and mental development of the students.
       Skill based certificate courses like spoken english, basic beautification coure arranged for students.
       The Alumni Association of the college is registered under Societies registration Act XXI of1860.
       The college organizes Career Counselling and Personality Development Programmes time to time to
       improve the overall personalities of the students

Governance, Leadership and Management

       Satya Ranjan College has a well-defined Vision and Mission; and the governance of the college reflects
       them.
       The instituition has decentralized governance system with proper well-defined and inter-relationships.
       The Governing body is the supreme decision-making body of the college.
       The principal of college being head of the institution is the overall head of both the academic and
       administrative affairs of the college.
       The college has created a decentralized structure for decision making where the committees of different
       department edge their decisions with college committees of the staff council. The Heads of all the
       departments work independently with the help of other faculty members of their departments.
       The handbook of Code of conduct and staff welfare policy uoloaded in college-website.
       The Internal Quality Assurance Cell (IQAC) is constituted as per the guidelines of NAAC to find out
       overall quality in teaching-learning, administrative and co-curricular and Extension activities.
       The strategic plan has the goals of Empowering students through Holistic education with proper
       guidance by all faculties of the institution, develop and strengthen academic programmes with full
       dedication and efficiency and to encourage faculties to do research work, Faculty Development
       Program, Refresher Course to enhance their academic career.
       All faculty members of the college are regularly motivated and they are also being awarded for a
       number of publications in book, journals etc in a year.
       Academic excellence of every staff is being recognized by the institution so that others could be
       motivated. Teacher’s performance as Co-Ordinator or Convenor of Workshops, seminars, FDP etc. are
       appreciated and being rewarded by certificates of appreciation.
       The college also adheres to the state government rule policy and all the staff can avail different types of
       casual leave, earned leave, Maternity and Child care leave for female staff, ON-Duty Leave etc.

The practice of decentralization and participatory management is possible in all the activities of the college
because of a strong and efficient organogram of the institution. The college has different organizational bodies
including students union for enactment of various activities. All the executive bodies are formed
democratically, they discuss relevant issues under their jurisdiction and resolved independently.


Institutional Values and Best Practices

       The college has taken initiatives to make familiar the concept of gender equity among the students by
       providing equal opportunity for students of both the genders and encouraging them to take part in
       various programmes.
        The College has taken initiatives to keep the campus clean and green. It has done its Environment and
       energy audits, Gender audit, academic and administrative audit for its self-analysis and development.
       The College has organized a number of programmes, academic and extra-curricular activities to create
       an atmosphere of tolerance, cultural harmony, communal, social & National integrity.
       In today's world, where maximum people are pursuing only self interests, the institution recognizes the
       need to inculcate Universal Values like respect to the elders, selflessness, kindness, truthfulness,
       etc. The College organises various programmes to sensitize the students regarding the moral values, and
       to bring everyone together and promote unity.
       All members of the college family are aware about their duties towards the institution, the state and the
       country and as responsible citizens, all takes part in state and national level elections, obeys rules and
       regulations of the constitution, follows directives and guidelines of the College code of Conduct.
